# Code Anchors: Review Posting Gate

- `libs/portable-tools/src/review-post.ts` — the posting command: the verdict requirement, the every-finding-carried check, the changed-lines reading from diff hunks, the per-comment file, line and expected-text checks that list every problem, the second-review check, the finding-number tag and the posted review's report.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/review-post.spec.ts` — coverage of each refusal, the context-line rule, the second-review confirmation and the posted payload.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — registers the posting command as a verb the skill invokes.
- `components/skills/nxs.code-review/SKILL.md` — the verdict question, the review file the skill writes, and how the skill handles each stop the posting command returns.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/code-review-posting.spec.ts` — coverage that the skill asks for a verdict, posts only through the command, and reports the link and both counts.
